title: FEAT — Add midday code-demo cron to ecosystem.config.js (scs001-pipeline-codedemo)
rationale: scs001-pipeline runs at 9am and produces 3 videos/day (1 per pipeline). With 13 days remaining and 18 posts needed, an extra code-demo run at 13:00 (free — all local: Ollama + Pillow + FFmpeg) adds 1 video/day at zero API cost. The code-demo pipeline now has LLM fallback templates (Sprint 1327) and per-step render isolation (Sprint 1330) so it runs reliably without Ollama. This increases daily video inventory from 3 to 4 without increasing fal.ai/ElevenLabs/HeyGen spend.

tasks.description: In ecosystem.config.js, add a new PM2 process 'scs001-pipeline-codedemo' after the existing scs001-pipeline block (line ~784). Config: same interpreter/env as scs001-pipeline, cron_restart: '0 13 * * *', args: '--pipeline code-demo --runs 1 --mode live', autorestart: false, error_file/out_file to scs001-pipeline-error.log/out.log.
